coverage.limit: Surveyed Accra trotro trips from May–June 2015, from Kasoa in the west to Tema Main Station in the east. Not a national Ghana stop list. Sixteen station names are a single letter or have only two stops, and several parks are spelled twice (Kaneshie/Kanashie, Agbogbloshie, Mallam Atta/Attah, Ashaiman/Ashiaman).
